sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Cavalrybane (鬼差高手 斩骑) is an optional encounter in Pangzhen, found at Statue Grounds bell, north of the long bridge. Beating it yields Armybreaker.

sections.title: Where to Find the Cavalrybane (鬼差高手 斩骑)
sections.content:
Location: Statue Grounds bell, north of the long bridge.

Appears in: Pangzhen.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: How to Beat the Cavalrybane (鬼差高手 斩骑)
sections.content:
What works

  • His strikes are predictable; parry instead of dodging for the faster punish.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 24 of 60 in the progression order, in Pangzhen. Before it: Blaze, Shadow Warden Captain (鬼差队长 火流星). After it: Wu Xuan, the Fallen General (堕落将军 武轩). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
